rules.title: Statement of Identity on Principal Display Panel
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: The principal display panel of a food in package form shall bear as one of its principal features a statement of the identity of the commodity.
evidenceRequirements: Extracted text quote on Front panel (PDP)
rules.verificationLimitations: Verifies presence and prominence of statement of identity on PDP.

rules.title: Net Quantity Dual Unit Declaration (US Customary and Metric)
rules.sourceLaw: Fair Packaging and Labeling Act
rules.sourceQuote: The declaration of net quantity of contents shall be expressed in terms of weight, measure, numerical count, or a combination thereof... in both avoirdupois and metric units.
evidenceRequirements: Extracted net quantity text declarations and unit normalization
rules.verificationLimitations: Evaluates commercial display rounding equivalence between ounces and grams.

rules.title: Responsible Party Name and Place of Business
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: The label of a food in packaged form shall specify conspicuously the name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer, or distributor.
evidenceRequirements: Extracted manufacturer, packer, or distributor address block
rules.verificationLimitations: Checks address structure including street or PO box, city, state and postal code.

rules.title: Ingredient List Declaration in Descending Order of Predominance
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: Ingredients required to be declared on the label... shall be listed by common or usual name in descending order of predominance by weight.
evidenceRequirements: Extracted ingredient statement text and sequence
rules.verificationLimitations: Checks heading preamble and sequencing consistency against formulation sheet.

rules.title: Compound Ingredient Sub-component Declaration
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: An ingredient which itself contains two or more ingredients shall be designated in the statement of ingredients... by declaring the established common or usual name of the ingredient followed by a parenthetical listing of all ingredients.
evidenceRequirements: Extracted parenthetical sub-ingredients (e.g. Crystallized Ginger (cane sugar))
rules.verificationLimitations: Verifies that compound components are declared parenthetically without silent truncation.

rules.title: Major Allergen Source Declaration (FALCPA / FASTER Act)
rules.sourceLaw: Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act
rules.sourceQuote: A food is misbranded unless the label declares the presence of each major food allergen in the ingredient list or in a Contains statement immediately adjacent.
evidenceRequirements: Declared ingredients matching FALCPA 8 + sesame allergen list
rules.verificationLimitations: Ensures all recipe major allergens are declared either in ingredient copy or Contains block.

rules.title: Tree Nut Specific Species Identification
rules.sourceLaw: Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act
rules.sourceQuote: The term 'major food allergen' means... tree nuts (and the specific type of nut). Generic 'tree nuts' is not permitted.
evidenceRequirements: Specific common name of tree nut species in ingredients
rules.verificationLimitations: Verifies specific species (Almonds, Pecans, Walnuts) instead of generic 'nuts'.

rules.title: Precautionary Allergen Advisory Statement Consistency
rules.sourceLaw: FDA Allergen Labeling Guidance & 21 U.S.C. 343(a)(1)
rules.legalProvision: FDA Guidance for Industry: Questions and Answers Regarding Food Allergens
rules.sourceQuote: Advisory statements should not be used in lieu of good manufacturing practices, and should not be used for ingredients intentionally added to the food.
evidenceRequirements: Comparison between intentional recipe ingredients and 'May Contain' copy
rules.verificationLimitations: Flags misleading overlap where intentional recipe nuts also appear in 'May Contain' box.

rules.title: Nutrition Facts Panel Presence and Format
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: Nutrition information relating to food shall be provided for all products intended for human consumption and offered for sale.
evidenceRequirements: Visible Nutrition Facts panel heading on packaging
rules.verificationLimitations: Verifies that an approved US Nutrition Facts panel is present on packaging.

rules.title: Serving Size Declaration and Reference Amount Customarily Consumed
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: The serving size shall be determined from the Reference Amounts Customarily Consumed (RACC) established in § 101.12(b).
evidenceRequirements: Extracted serving size declaration (e.g. 85g / 2/3 cup)
rules.verificationLimitations: Checks presence of metric and household measure for serving size.

rules.title: Servings Per Container × Serving Size Mathematical Consistency
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: The number of servings shall be based on the serving size recommended... The total weight accounted for by servings must match the package net weight within allowable rounding.
evidenceRequirements: Servings per container, serving size mass, and package net weight
rules.verificationLimitations: Validates that Servings × Serving Size aligns with declared Net Weight.

rules.title: Nutrition Facts Calorie Declaration and Atwater Energy Plausibility
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: Caloric content may be calculated by the following methods... using the general factors of 4, 4, and 9 calories per gram for protein, total carbohydrate, and total fat.
evidenceRequirements: Declared calories, fat, carbohydrate, and protein per serving
rules.verificationLimitations: Screening heuristic. Specific Atwater factors or fiber deductions may apply lawfully.

rules.title: Total Fat % Daily Value Calculation
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: A statement of the number of grams of total fat in a serving... accompanied by the percent Daily Value based on 78g reference Daily Value.
evidenceRequirements: Declared Total Fat amount and declared %DV
rules.verificationLimitations: Calculates (grams / 78g) * 100 with legally specified rounding.

rules.title: Saturated Fat % Daily Value Calculation
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: A statement of the number of grams of saturated fat in a serving... accompanied by the percent Daily Value based on 20g reference Daily Value.
evidenceRequirements: Declared Saturated Fat amount and declared %DV
rules.verificationLimitations: Calculates (grams / 20g) * 100 with legally specified rounding.

rules.title: Cholesterol % Daily Value Calculation
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: A statement of the cholesterol content in a serving... accompanied by the percent Daily Value based on 300mg reference Daily Value.
evidenceRequirements: Declared Cholesterol amount and declared %DV
rules.verificationLimitations: Calculates (mg / 300mg) * 100 with legally specified rounding.

rules.title: Sodium % Daily Value Calculation
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: A statement of the number of milligrams of sodium in a serving... accompanied by the percent Daily Value based on 2300mg reference Daily Value.
evidenceRequirements: Declared Sodium amount and declared %DV
rules.verificationLimitations: Calculates (mg / 2300mg) * 100 with legally specified rounding.

rules.title: Total Carbohydrate % Daily Value Calculation
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: A statement of the number of grams of total carbohydrate in a serving... accompanied by the percent Daily Value based on 275g reference Daily Value.
evidenceRequirements: Declared Total Carbohydrate amount and declared %DV
rules.verificationLimitations: Calculates (grams / 275g) * 100 with legally specified rounding.

rules.title: Dietary Fiber, Total Sugars and Added Sugars Declarations
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: Added sugars must be stated as 'Includes X g Added Sugars' with % Daily Value (based on 50g DV). Total Sugars has no Daily Value.
evidenceRequirements: Declared Total Sugars and Added Sugars with %DV
rules.verificationLimitations: Verifies Added Sugars %DV (based on 50g) and confirms Total Sugars has no DV.

rules.title: Mandatory Vitamin D, Calcium, Iron and Potassium Declarations
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: Vitamin D, calcium, iron, and potassium shall be declared by quantitative amount and % Daily Value (Vit D: 20mcg, Ca: 1300mg, Fe: 18mg, K: 4700mg).
evidenceRequirements: Quantitative amounts and %DV for the four mandatory micronutrients
rules.verificationLimitations: Verifies presence and tiered rounding rules for mandatory micronutrients.

rules.title: 'No Added Sugar' Nutrient Content Claim Substantiation
rules.sourceLaw: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
rules.sourceQuote: The terms 'no added sugar' or 'without added sugar' may be used only if no sugar or sugar-containing ingredient is added during processing.
evidenceRequirements: Marketing claim text, ingredient statement, and declared added sugars
rules.verificationLimitations: Disqualifies claim if honey, coconut sugar, cane sugar or >0g added sugars are present.

rules.title: Barcode Check Digit Verification (GS1 Modulo 10)
rules.sourceLaw: GS1 General Specifications / ISO/IEC 15420
rules.sourceQuote: The check digit is calculated on all preceding digits of the GTIN using a weighted modulo 10 algorithm.
evidenceRequirements: Extracted barcode symbol digits and symbology type
rules.verificationLimitations: Validates check digit only; does not verify print contrast or GS1 company assignment.
